environment: local isolated Wrangler D1; provider from local api/.dev.vars; no secret values recorded

cases.assessment: API success is not accepted: the returned scene has fewer objects than bound locations, so several required core structures are not represented. The draft was not persisted.

海边旧车站旁的小街，路边有咖啡馆、花园和安静的住宅。

cases.prompt: 沿用原来的主楼、温室、庭院、书房和湖畔，补齐入口之间可步行的石板路。
cases.assessment: The original world had one resident, one timeline, five locations, and no scene revisions before the attempt. Repair draft failed; no save was attempted and the original world remained unchanged.
